children: According to the announcement from Binance, the platform has launched a new Word of the Day (WOTD) game centered on the theme “Binance Stock Options.” The activity period runs from 2026-09-14 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-09-20 23:59 (UTC). During this period, eligible users can play the educational word-guessing game to test their knowledge of the topic and earn a share of rewards. Binance said users may play up to two WOTD games per day, and those who achieve at least five correct answers will be eligible for a share of a 3,000 USDC reward pool. A second reward pool of 7,000 USDC is available to users who also complete a cumulative trading volume of $50 equivalent in non-zero fee trades, including Spot, Convert, TradFi, BStock, or Futures. Rewards are distributed based on each user’s proportion of correct answers, with a maximum reward cap of 5 USDC per user. Binance said all rewards will be distributed by 2026-10-04 23:59 (UTC) directly to the user’s Rewards Hub, and eligible users must claim vouchers before expiration. The announcement also noted that users can unlock the second WOTD game by clicking “Get A New WOTD” after the first game, sharing the featured link on social media, and having the shared link clicked by a logged-in user.

Binance also said new users who register for an account using the “WOTD” referral code or the referral link during the Activity Period will receive 10% off Spot trading fees. These users may also qualify for additional welcome rewards by completing tasks in the Rewards Hub within 14 days after registration. The announcement described WOTD as an educational game designed to help users expand crypto vocabulary and follow market developments. Binance added that the promotion may not be available in certain regions and that only eligible users who complete account verification can participate and receive rewards.

title: Binance Launches Word of the Day Game on Binance Stock Options
